page.overview:
Who is Daz?

Daz is a that runs the , a located in the in the . He gathers his wares himself, from both within and outside the Forest.

When asked, Daz explains that the General Shoppe sells and that he thought would be useful to . He recommends using while it's raining to deal extra damage to enemies.

In addition to selling his wares, Daz will purchase from Link. He asks Link to sell whatever he doesn't need, since he enjoys seeing Items from outside of the Korok Forest. He's very pleased to see Link's . Daz is grateful when Link sells to him, occasionally demanding more Items.
